photos.desc: A jaw fragment of a new unnamed species of Purgatorius from the Willow Creek Formation of Alberta. On display at the Royal Tyrrell Museum in Drumheller, Alberta.
Purgatorius , from the Late Paleocene of North America, believed to be the earliest primate. Fossil ankles show that Purgatorius lived in trees.
Life restoration of the giant dromaeosaurid Dakotaraptor steini , with the bird species Lamarqueavis petra and the mammal Purgatories in the foreground.
